description: This file defines the EssUserRole class which extends AbstractUserRole and manages user permissions for performance reviews, trackers, logs, and quick launch features within the OrangeHRM system. It uses multiple traits for services and contains methods to retrieve accessible entity IDs based on user permissions and context.

classes.name: EssUserRole
classes.description: Class responsible for managing user role permissions and access to various performance review and tracking entities for Employee Self Service in OrangeHRM.

methods.name: getAccessibleIdsForEntity
methods.description: Returns array of entity IDs accessible to the user based on entity type and permissions.

methods.name: getAccessibleReviewIds
methods.description: Retrieves a list of review IDs for the current employee, filtered by allowed review statuses.

methods.name: getAccessiblePerformanceTrackerIdsForESS
methods.description: Fetches performance tracker IDs associated with the current user.

methods.name: getAccessiblePerformanceTrackerLogIdsForESS
methods.description: Fetches performance tracker log IDs associated with the current user.

methods.name: getAccessibleQuickLaunchList
methods.description: Provides the quick launch options available to the user.
